observations.name: next 2 obstacles
observations.expr: (() => { const p = player, L = []; for (const e of enemies) if (e.alive && e.x + e.w > p.x) L.push([e.x, e.w, e.h, 1, 0, 0]); for (const o of pits) if (o.x + o.w > p.x) L.push([o.x, o.w, 0, 0, 1, 0]); for (const o of pipes) if (o.x + o.w > p.x) L.push([o.x, o.w, o.h, 0, 0, 1]); L.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]); const out = []; for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) { const o = L[k]; out.push(o ? 1 : 0, o ? (o[0] - p.x - p.w) / 300 : 2, o ? (o[0] + o[1] - p.x) / 300 : 2, o ? o[2] / 60 : 0, o ? o[3] : 0, o ? o[4] : 0, o ? o[5] : 0); } return out; })()
